en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a Nordic coastal inlet full of floating timber logs. On the right shoreline stand several small wooden boathouses and sheds, with rowing boats and small motorboats moored along the water. Forested hills line the background under a partly cloudy sky. The lower left printed text reads "Lövånger. Kallviken." and in the lower right corner is a printer's credit indicating a photo publisher from Hälsingborg.
